To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MDR1 gene expression is increased in some patients with medically refractory epilepsy.
MDR1 expression in brain of some intractable epilepsy patients is increased and that this increased expression is associated with decreased accumulation of AED within epileptic tissue.
MDR1 expression in brain of patients with medically in tractable epilepsy is increased and may contribute to lack of responsiveness to AEDs in these patients.

a possible molecular mechanism of drug resistance in patients with medically in tractable epilepsy.
understanding the mechanisms underlying medically intractable seizures.
the mechanisms of drug resistance in epilepsy.
